sources.label: Morphe patches that de-ads Opera Browser / Opera Beta / Opera GX: removes sponso
sources.author: Vogelkop
patch_list: Replaces Opera's hidden partner whitelists (Google/Yandex measurement, Taboola, gambling and shopping affiliates, AppsFlyer/Adjust/Kochava/CJ tracking domains) with empty filter lists, so the built-in ad blocker actually blocks them.
Prevents Opera from loading its bundled third-party ad network modules (Liftoff/Vungle, Mintegral, Pangle/ByteDance) by breaking the reflective class lookup used by the ad mediation layer.

Stops Firebase Analytics, Google Ads/Doubleclick/IMA and Leanplum from collecting or sending usage data by rewriting their endpoint constants to a dead host. Firebase infrastructure that features depend on (push notifications, feature flag…

Prevents the "Your app installation appears to be broken. Try to uninstall and reinstall" dialog from blocking startup. The dialog is Opera's crash-recovery nag (it also appears on unmodified installs after a crash or inside app-cloning to…

Stops a failed engine boot (MainLibraryBoot) from deadlocking the welcome screen. The Chromium engine ships inside the APK; if its load or start still fails (device without ARM support, a start error), Opera announces the failure to the we…
Stops sponsored/partner tiles from appearing on the start page by making Opera's suggested-sites database queries return no rows. Regular Speed Dial entries and bookmarks are not affected.

Makes the app see the original Opera signing certificate after Morphe re-signs it. Opera's code reads its own signature in several places (preinstall partner checks, the MoMi SDK, metrics), and a patched build would answer those reads with…
